[[Heart of the Mountain]] Tier 4 |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Going Even Deeper|Going Even Deeper]]" |prev_location=[[Mithril Deposits]] |resources=*Gemstone *[[Golden Dragon Egg]] }} The '''Dragon's Lair''' is the unofficial name of a location in the {{Zone|Crystal Hollows}} where players can buy the {{Item|Golden Dragon Egg}}. It rarely spawns in the {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}}. When a player is getting closer to the '''Dragon's Lair''', the sound of a dragon's wings flapping begins to play, occasionally accompanied by a roar. == Interface == {{:Golden Dragon/UI}} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Trivia == * Entering the '''Dragon's Lair''' for the first time awards the player with the {{ach|How to train your dragon?|ach=true}}. * The '''Dragon's Lair''' the dragon itself and its first line of dialogue are a reference to [https://tolkiengateway.net/wiki/Smaug ''Smaug''] from the [https://tolkiengateway.net/wiki/The_Hobbit ''The Hobbit'']. * Purchasing a {{Item|Golden Dragon Egg}} award the player with the {{ach|The Golden Dragon's Egg|ach=true}}. * Before the {{Changelog|2026/September 17|alt=September 17th, 2026}} update, only maximum of three {{Item|Golden Dragon Egg}}s could be purchased in each lobby. * The [[Golden Dragon Pet|Golden Dragon]] is one of few [[NPC]]s that can talk despite being blocks: other similar [[NPC]]s are the [[Jade Dragon]] and [[Oruo the Almighty]]. == Gallery == File:Dragon's Top View.png|Dragon's Top View File:Dragon's POV.png|Dragon's P.O.V File:Dragon's Head.png|Dragon's Head File:Dragon's Backside.png|Dragon's Backside File:Golden Dragon Eggs in the Dragon's Lair.png|Golden Dragon Eggs in the Dragon's Lair == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|ahn-0.12-r1|Added '''Dragon's Lair'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.12|Added '''Dragon's Lair'''.}} {{History|2026/Sep 17|Removed the limit of {{Item|Golden Dragon Egg}}s.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Crystal Hollows}}
